verdict.rationale: Tailscale's docs describe setting up a webhook to receive notifications of events on a tailnet, and list webhooks among its automation integrations. That directly covers subscribing to events via webhooks. The evidence is only short doc summaries, though, so depth and breadth can't be confirmed. Missing for 10: details on supported event types, payload format and delivery/retry or signing, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
